correctness.rationale: Consecutive records satisfy \(r'=r-1+\ell(r-1)\). If a missing target \(x\equiv25\pmod{30}\) lies inside a record gap, the cases \(\ell=3\) and \(\ell=5\) are impossible by parity and a modulo-\(6\) contradiction. For \(\ell\ge7\), the gap starts at \(r\equiv1\pmod{30}\); swallowing the next \(25\pmod{30}\) residue requires a gap exceeding \(24\), so \(\ell\ge29\), forcing \(23\#\mid r-1\) and hence \(x\ge23\#+25\). A direct primorial argument proves \(23\#+1\) is a record, and its next record is \(23\#+29\), so \(23\#+25\) is indeed skipped.
